facts.fact: Mercedes Sosa was born Haydée Mercedes Sosa on July 9, 1935, in San Miguel de Tucumán, Tucumán, Argentina.
Mercedes Sosa died on October 4, 2009, in Buenos Aires, Argentina, at the age of 74.
Sosa was known as a prominent figure in the nueva canción movement and was often referred to as the 'voice of the voiceless ones'.
She was active in her musical career from 1950 until her death in 2009.
Mercedes Sosa is celebrated for giving voice to songs written by both Brazilian and Cuban artists.

result.summary: Mercedes Sosa, born on July 9, 1935, in Argentina, was a prominent Argentine singer known for her contributions to the nueva canción movement and her ability to represent marginalized voices. She passed away on October 4, 2009, at the age of 74, leaving a legacy of musical influence spanning several decades.
